After an unusually long three-week wait, the new beta updates are now rolling out to developers starting today, including iPadOS 27 beta 5 and several other versions. Here are the details.

iPadOS 27 beta 5 and more Apple updates have been released

With less than a month and change until the official public release of iOS 27, this typically signals that the pace of beta releases is about to quicken.

Apple today has pushed beta 5 to iPadOS 27, watchOS 27, tvOS 27, visionOS 27, and more.

For now, only developers can download and install the new updates. However, if Apple follows its usual practice, public beta versions of the same software should be released within a day or two.

At this stage of the beta cycle, we do not expect to find any major user interface changes in Apple's software. On the contrary, August is usually when two main things happen with Apple betas:

  • New beta versions are released more frequently, typically once a week but with fewer noticeable changes
  • Apple's focus shifts to bug fixes and performance improvements

Apple has emphasised that new software versions such as iOS 27 will deliver performance gains over the previous generation.

Although this is already true to some extent within the betas, it can be expected that Apple's new software will run more smoothly in beta 5 and the coming weeks, with more bugs ironed out.

That said, if there are any new features or noteworthy changes in today's updates, we will let you all know.

Have you spotted anything new in iPadOS 27 beta 5 or any of the other versions? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
